tei:div.tei:p: /ḍa — — ——— — —da —— —byed ba kyi byed snyed bye ka ( 1 — —sgyu— ḍa ma snye—dka / bsnyed byed de ༷ snyespyoX—1 —da rdokadz+wadihūṃ sna byedape ba re / sdo hūṃ— snyed de de byedaram̐mi ribs dpe skrun khang /
mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i rna rgyanaXzhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rin spungs ngab dbang 'jigs grags kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

1 'go brngod/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i sngon rjes su bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis rgya gar gyi rig gnas kyi gzhung snyan ngag me long〉dang 1 bstan brtsos dpag bsam 'khri shing〉1 klu kun tu dga' ba〉sogs mngon brjod kyi ka snyad kyis spras pa mab po bod yig tu bsgyur cing 1 dus mtshungs su rgya gar gyi mkhas pa 'chi med seng ges mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos 'che ba med pa'i mdzod〉ces pa de bod kyi mkhas pa yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bal yul gyi yam bu'i grong khyer du bod yig tu bsgyur cing 1 'gos lo tsā bas rgya dpe dang 'gyur yig rnying par gtugs nas don la ci nus kyis dpyad de 'gyur bde bar mdzad nas par du bteb pa red1 de nas bzung bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa'i gzhung mas su mngon brjod kyi ba snyad ji mang du phyin yod par ma zad mngon brngod kyi bston brtsas kyang mang po mdzad yod pa red mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos mkhas pa'i rna rgyan〉zhes pa 'di ni bod kyi mkhas pa rnams bkyis mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos mang po'i nang nas legs 'dzoms pa'i gras shig red/ deb 'di'i rtsom pa po ni sde pa rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pa'i rdo rje min/ khong zhe gsung rtsom 'di mi dmangs kyi khrod du skad grags chen po yod pas dus rabs brtso brgyad pa'i kabs spu tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pas mjug byang mdzad nas sheng par brkos myub zhing 1 da lta bod smongs lha sa'i zhol par khang du yod pa'i par sheng ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus dkyim ma brgos pa zhig red—

spya sgyudabod kyi mngon brjod kyi ka snyad rnam grangs ha cang mang bas ha lam chos grid kyi dngos po gang la'ang mngon brjod kyis ma khyab sa med1 dper na gzhung 'di nyid las/ rgya' dang rgya' zas slob mar bcas/ sa gsum 'jig rten khams ma lus1 —rigs drug 'gro ba la sogs pa/ zhes gsungs pa lhar dang 1de bzhin mngon brjod kyi grub stangs kyang 'dra min sna tshogs yod/ dper na gzhung 'di nyid las1 don gcig ming mang ming gcig la1 —don mang 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming 1 1rjes grub btags ming gnyis byu bshad1 1btags ming 'dra ba rgyu mtshan dab 1 —'brel ba rgyu mtshan du bkod las/ /gyi ma rgyu dang 'bras byur rgyu1 /phyogs 'a phyogs can cha shas sogs1 /rted la brten pa dngos rdog pa 1 1ba)gas sogs mngon par brjod pa'i ming zhes gtsungs pa lta bu red—bod kyi gna' gzhub mang che ba'i nang mngon brjod bgrangs kyis mi mangs pa yod par brten gna' gzhung la brtag dpyad byed na mngon brjod kyi dpe deb cig nges par du dgos kyi red— mngon brngod shes na ming la mi rmongs zhes pa'i gna' mi'i bshad rgyun ltar mngon brjod shes na jir nas yod pa'i gzhung la lha kabs de dag gi don rnams ji ma ji bzhin du rtogs thub pa dang — gsar du rtsom tshe dbas bab kyi brjod bya'i don der ka stad gang la ci 'os rab byan du sbyar te rjod ཿga snyan zhing 'jibs la brjod don gsal por ston thub par ma da1 mngon brjod kyi ka snyad grub stangs rnams dper bzung rte rjes grub kyi ming tshig gsar pa'ang bzo thub kyi red1 der brten nga tshos bod rjongs kyi lha sa'i rgol par khang gi par ma gzhir bzung nas legs jig byas te deb 'di par du bskrun pa min1 ma dpe 'di sde tshan zu nas 8ga byu bcad de bas pa'i gzung zheg ba ma1 dang gzhes mtho jis kyi sde tshan dang 1 mag

rngod 3 gi sde tshan1 sa gzhi'i sde smon spyi'i sde tshan bcas bzhi yod klog pa po rnams gzigs bde ba'i ched du nga tshos deb 'di kag gnyis su bsgrigs yod/khag dang po ni mngon brngod kyi gzhung dngos yin zhing de sngar gyi tshigs bcad ltar bsgrigs shing 1 le'u bzhe dang sa bcad nyer gnyis rgyu phye thog kha byang re'ang bkod yod/ khag gnyis pa ni gzhung dngos nang gi mngon brjod rnams ka phreng snar bsgrigs thog rgya yig tu bsgyur yod pas dngos ming ma brten nas mngon brjod kyi ka snyad btsal chog la mngon brjod la brten nas dngos ming btsal na'ang btsal chog de min rgya yig la brten nas mngon brjod 'tshol bde ba'i ched du rgya yig sgro sbyor ltar spu snyad 'tshol kabs kyi re'u mig〉cig kyang bkod yod cing 1 klog pa po rnams la dpyad gzhi yong ched deb mnug tu dus bzhi'i ming gi mngon brjod〉dang 1 bod zla bcu gnyis kyi mngon brngod 〉 tshes grangs so so'i ming 1〉 gza' bdun gyi mngon brjod1〉 rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi mngon brjod 〉 grangs kyi mngon brjod 〉 rab byung dang spyi lospung ka'i rgyal rabs so so'i srid lo bcas bas jigs kyi re'u mig〉 lo 'khor drug cu'i re'u mig〉bcas kung zur 'don gyis bkod yod1gzhan yab spung dbyang mi rigs smob ka chen mo'i ca'o zu'u ga kan pa dung dkar blo bzab 'phrin mas labs kyis (mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos mkhas pa'i ka rgyan〉gyi ma dpe'i skor sge gsal bshad〉cig mdzad par ma da1 gzhub dngo nang phud pa'i dka' gnad mang po kal rogs kung gnang yod pa dab 1de bzhen bshes gnyen rdo rje rgyam po lags kyis kang rtso sgyur byed mkhan la rod ram bgrangs kyis mi langs pa mdzad yod ba bab snying ga pa nas zugs rje che rgya gi yin/

sgrig sgyur byed mkhan gyi chu tshad dman pas dpe deb 'di'i nang ba skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yong srid pas par gzhi rjes mar dag brtsas yo bzang byed sbyo/ she/// ched mkhyen ldan klog pa po tshos dgongs 'a ra ji mchis lhug stol yong sgrig sgyur pas11381 lo'i zla lha tshes 8la1

6 dkar chaga'ad brjod1 1 mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsas mkhas pa'i rdo rgyan〉gyi ma dpe'i skor gyi gsal bshad1 ༷ mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsas mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ 1le'u dang po1 mtho ris kyi sde tshan1 6sa bcad dang po1 sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma sogs pa'i skor1 rtas bzud gnyis pa— lha la sogs pa'i sgor1 sa bzud gas pa1 nam mkha' sogs pa'i skor1 rtaXs bcad bzhi pa1 dus dang ba la pa la sogs pa'i skor1 36le'u gnyis pa1 sa 'og gi sde tshan1 spyas bcad dang po1 sa 'og dang dka ba tsā dgas ma sogs pa'i skor1 lhas bcad gnyi pa1 chu dang chu'i srog gas la sogs pa'i skor1 6sa bzud gsum pa1 gzings dang chu skyes ma sogs pa'i skor 6༷le'u gsum pa1 sa gzhi'i sde tshan1 53sa bcad dang po— sa ma sogs pa'i skor1 ༷ 63sa ba6da gnyis pa ri ma sogs pa'i skor 65sa bcad gsum pa1 grong ma sogs pa'i skor1 5༷sa bcad bzhe pa— nags dang sman ma sog pa'i skor— 61

༷ 〈mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos mkhas pa'i rna rgyan〉gyi ma dpe'i skor gyi gsa' bshad1 mngon brjod kyi bstan brtsos mkhas pa'i rna rgyan〉'di'i rtsom pa po ni1sde pa jin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig grags yin1 bod kyi rab byung brgyad pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1482lor 'khyungs1 rab byung dgu pa'i dkyim tsam ma 'das1 khong ni bod kyi ri mo la ha cang mkhas pa zhig yin zhing 1 lo rgyus thog skadagrags yod pa'i rigs ldan yol ba zhes pa'i gos thang de yang khong gis thig tshad dang ri mo bris nas bzhengs pa da lta'ang rtse po ta ma'i bang mdzod nang du yod mus dang 1 de bzhin khong gis lo gsar gyi rjos gar sde brgyad bstod 'tshams zhes pa'i gar dang spu dbyangs bcas kyang brtsams pa de sngon tā la'i bla ma'i pho brang gi mdzad sgo'i skabs 'khrib kyi yod1rtsom yig ha cang mang po zhig yod tshod kyang 1 skad grags yod pa'i rtsom yig ni/ khams kyi rgyal phran mnga' ris dang bcas pa rnams la sprengs yig dbyangs can rig pa'i rgya mtsho〉la grangs 102rang lo zhe lnga pa rab byung dgu pa'i me khyi 16spya6lor brtsams pa1 snyan ngag me long zhe 'grel pa mi 'jigs seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro〉bris ma la grangs 333yod pa— snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing gi 'grel pa dmar mchan〉sogs yod1 mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i rgyan〉'di di rang lo bzhi bcu pa rab byung dgu pa'i lcags sgrol 16ཿ1lor brtsams shing — de sngon bod kyi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan brjod dang nas rgyas

10 — ba shos shig yin1 'di ma lha sa rgom par khang gi par gsar rnying gnyis dang 1sde dge par ma bcas yod/ de sngon nga rang gi mi thog gsum pa'i phyag dpe'i gras kyi mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i dz+wa rgyan〉bris ma zhig yod pa de dang gong gsam gyi par ma khag gsum po lha bsdur byed skabs gong gsal par ma'i nang mgo mjug bar gsum nas yig phreng lnga bcu nga brgyad tsam chad skyon byung 'dug pa kabs der sdum par thog par bskrun byed rtsis yin rung de nas lo phyed lhag tsam ma song bar rig gnas gsar brje chen po tshugs te snga rabs kyi lo rgyus dang — rig gnas1 sgrung deb sogs dpe rgyun ha cang dkon pa'i rigs mang po brlags par brten dib kabs ma dpe de rigs ha cang dkon pa bcas blo pham che yang — da dung gong gsam gyi dpe deb bris ma de gras yod med zhib 'jug thog de rigs rnyed tshe par ma dang phan tshun go bsdur byed dgos pa bcas dgongs 'jags zhu1 dub dkar rngo ba rda 'dzin mas kyi 1981 tshu'i tshu lha'i 20ma1

jibs dang shes rab phul byung las 'khrungs bla na med pa'i ye shes kyis1 mas cad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes yon tad rkang pa drug pa bder gshegs po'i—snyeng po'i pad ma kun sbyis za ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can dbang phyugargyal ba'i tog rgyur brtsom ldan bka seng ge'i zhabs dag spyi bos mchod1mi shes zun pa brtsam ma kangs pa'i rgyu med dus gsum gyi1sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pa tshad med jogs pa'i shes rab la1longs su spyod pas brgyan pa'i mthu yis 'gro rnams kun mkhyen du1byed pa'i mgon po zur phud lnga pas rjes su gzung bar mdzod—rgyud mang spu mas dam chos rtag pa'i sgro ma lus1sbyin pa'i phyag gi gdu bu 'a ka ba pa'i dbyangs snyan ni1mdzes sdug mi skyo'i grogs su kun dga'i ro ldan pa1dbyangs can ma kye ngag gi dbang phyug(1ba)grub tu gsol1

rngod sgyudashes bya'i rang bzhin kun nas yangs pa'i dpal1mtha' dag 'byor ba'i lang tshos dregs pa mo'i1mid— 'ong snying gar reg pa'i do shel 'dzum1mdza' ba'i bsam pa go 'byed ming nas 'bod1rgyal dang rgyal gras slob mar bcas/sa gsum 'jig rten khams ma lus1rigs drug 'gro ba la sogs pa—don gcig ming mang ming gcig la—don mang 'dod rgyal smog ma'i ming rjes grub btags ming gnyis su bshad1btags ming 'dra ba rgyu mtshan dang 1'brel ba rgyu mtshan du bkod phas1phyi ma rgyu dang 'bras bur rgyur1phyogs la myugs can shas tshogs1rten la brten pa dngos ldog pas1btags sogs mngon par brngod pa'i ming —ma rdo' dag chu bo'i gter 'di masabasnams pa'i legs bshad mkhas pa yi1 (3na)rgyan 'in chen 'od 'bar ba1ga ma ma rngogs pa 'dir bshad bya—

le'u dar po/ ba ris kyi sde tshan/sa bcad dar po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'a sogs pa'i skor/ro rje 'am ba gi mtshan rigs kun khyab bdag rigs brgya'i bdaganges pa lnga lda rdo rje can1 kha sgor bdud ldan gsang jigs rgyal drug pa rdo rje 'a nga chen no1dpal dus kyi 'khor za'i mtshan mchog gi dab po'i sangs rgyas dang 1 thabs shes bdag nyid rdo rje sems1 me waṃ yi ge rigs med pa/shes dang shes bya'i bdag nyid mchog zhi ba sdom la 'dus pa dang 'pho med thog ma ji ma med1 rigs kun khyab bdag byang chub sems1 rnal 'byor rnam pa kun mchog ldan1 thog ma'i mgon po gnyis su med khams gsum 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / ṭī ka la tsakra rnams/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor yo'o1kye ro rje'i mtshan1 dgyes pa rdo rje lha badz+ra1 dpal ldan khrig 'thung nye ru ka dpyid dang rdo rje gri gug dang 1 rol pa'i rdo rje kye rdo rje—bde mchog gi mtshan1 'khor lo sdom pa ri khrod pa1 dpa' bo

snye ji kyi ji 1rdo rje thod pa can1 zla ba'i rtsod pan mas 'a 'gro'i dbang 1 rdo rje 'khor lo bde mchog gosabs zus thi'i mtshan (de nga bdud ma zu ba na1)rgyal ba bdud 'dul (1na rngong pa'i bdud— phub po'i bdud— 'che bdag bdud1 lha'i byu'i bdud di bskyi du bas—)'jig rten ( dod pa dang — gzug dab — gzud da pa'i ma zu— zum pas na)'dul(ma)1 sangs rgyas bde gshegs de(spyab)bzhin gshegs(pa1 sgyub ma rna sa ji ra zun pa di bzhen duX bar gsheg pas da—)khyab bdag kun mkhyen dus gsum mkhyen1 chags bral chags 'joms sku gsum pa1 kun tu bzang po bams cad mkhyen1 spums cad rtogs dang(sku da di bdud man ma di thum ba—)lus med thul1 (sgyub pa ni )na thos dang 1 ra nga rgya ༷min ma— di dag gi ༷ma por sgyur pas—)thub pa'i dbang po mkhyen lnga pa1 'gro ba'i bla ma ldams cad gzigs1rkang gnyis gtso bo brtsom ldan 'das1 bdag nyid chen po kams cad sgrol—chos kyi dbang phyug dran pa'i dgra1 mngon shes drug ldan(di lha'i jid dang rna ba dab 1ga na ma shes —nga rjon da— don— ga pa da she sgyu zu she — zhe pa rter ro—)stobs bcu pa1 ( nas da na ma mid pa dang 1 sa kyi ma par na ma dab — pa tshod pa dab 1 ba du dab 1 dbab po chod dang rngod ma min ma dang — mam ma cad dab 1kun nas 1na mong ka dang par zung pa da 1 rjon ༷ gnas rje tsu dran ba dab 1 che 'tshu dang zu ba dang 1 da pa da pa khyen pa'iXstobs dang lda— pa'o—)rnam par 'dren pa chos kyi rgyal1 legs gsung gnyis med gsung ba dang — mkha' mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa1 ston pa sangs rgyas spyi ma mtshan1shākya zub pha'i mtshan bu ram shing pa(— jig kyi mib rte— de za 1rjon jig shig rjes pa bda' zheg mas ༷ po'i da ma byung snye gas shing ma bskyon rdo1di'i ming ga bon babs ) du— na byu bam gyi shing mad pa sgyung pas sheng de bon ba ba ngo — (3na)snye 'od kyi brgyang pa khyezu ga byung ba de'i jid rgyud ba pa ——)

— — ba kyi — 1nyi ma'i rus(dang )1 nyi ma'i rigs 'khrungs(dang )nyi ma'i rgyud0(dab )— nyi ma'i gnyen gur(ma da pan)rga ta ma1 lha yi yang lha lha yi lha1 mi mjid snying po zas gtsang gras1 shu ku(di tshud pa dang nus pa snye de dam rdon ba'o)seng ge(di de dag ga bor zur pas so)shu ba'i tog dge sbyong chen po tshul khrims gter/ rdo rje gdan pa shukya thub bo—sabs rgyas snams kyi yon nyan kyi khyadaXpar sangs rgyab rnams khyad par chos1 mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa yi1 phung po lnga dang me shes bzhi/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ni/ ma 'dres chos ni brtso brgyad dang 1 thugs rje chen po sum cu gnyis ma 'dres dran pa nyer gzhag gsum1bsrung ba med pa bzhi dang di1 so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug de las byung ba'i rdzu 'grul dang 1 cho 'phrul dag ni rnam ba gnum1 mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang 1 dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan/ mdo las bshad pa'i che ba dang 1 gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'o1zub chub sems dpa' sbyi'i mtshan byang chub sems dpa' sems dba' che1 rgyal zas rgyal ba'i myu gu dang 1 'phags chen po dang 'phags pa'i mchog byang chub cems dba' snyi mi mtshan1zar chub sems dpa' zums pa'i ma tshan1 rgyal tsha mi zam mgon po dang 1 sa bcu'i dbang phyug ma pham ba1 dga' ldan bzhugs dang dga' rdon bdag byams chen mgon po byams pa'o1ba dbabs kyi mtshan brtan pa'i 'khor tsā ral gri can1zur phud lnga pa rngo mi gter1 ngag gi dbab phyug(3ba)kang ge rtsen— ba ba'i kun ma ba da che ka1 dug
